integrity: The graph, PL orbit model, two-star cover, path recurrence and finite verifier are supplied with the theorem. Finite experiments corroborate but do not establish the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: For at least three complete-graph labels and at least one positive layer, only transitive label actions and one-fixed-label actions transitive on the remaining labels are classified; no ambient equivariant homotopy splitting, general subgroup classification, or independent mathematical validation is claimed. Equivalent unindexed work is not excluded.
title: A subgroup fixed-space transition for generalized Mycielskian independence complexes
